title: aws-spend-guardrail config
description: One config document for the guard in one payer (management) account.

payer_account_id.description: The payer (management) account this document is for.

defaults.description: Values a scope takes when it doesn't set them.

scopes.description: Accounts and OUs protected by a budget.

excluded_accounts.description: Accounts left out of protection on purpose. The guard never reports them as unprotected.

alert_emails.description: Email addresses that receive the guard's local alerts, besides the stack's AlertEmail. Adding or removing one needs the same approval as loosening protection. Each address confirms its subscription once.

ou_id.description: An OU id. An organization root id (r-...) matches the pattern only so that it can be refused with a clear message.

threshold_pct.description: Percentage of the ceiling at which the freeze fires.

freeze_style.description: A: deny listed cost-creating actions. B: deny everything except reads, cost-reducing actions, and support, billing and security tooling.

mode.description: dry-run records would_freeze without attaching anything; enforce attaches the freeze policy.

month_end.description: What happens to a frozen scope when a new budget period starts.
